evidence_kind: Compact projection of the actual validator report; every matrix and interaction context is retained. Per-element samples remain in the raw report.

rawReport.storage: Temporary browser run directory; not distributed with this repository.

scope: Neobrutalism on nine bounded palette/font/corner profiles; complete existing theme apps are outside this evaluation
contrastMethod: Actual computed sRGB foreground, background and border colors, composited through opaque/transparent ancestor fills. No gradients, whole-element opacity, filters or blend modes are accepted in the measured path. Visible HTML text requires 4.5:1 (large text 3:1); field border against both fill and parent requires 3:1; buttons require a border or fill distinguishable from their parent at 3:1. External keyboard outline is measured against its adjacent parent at 3:1. Every measured sample is retained in the raw report.

checks.name: Nine actual profiles; native labels, one h1/main and no positive tabindex
72 matrix states: computed text/control contrast, 320/1280px reflow, 44px targets and opaque outlined surfaces
144 measured interaction states across every light/dark profile
Keyboard inspection, empty/filter recovery and retained selected detail
Minimum-length validation, valid local review and draft/filter/selection retention across all style preferences
System appearance follows live OS changes
Optional 2px active press and OS reduced-motion override of explicit motion-on
Forced-color system roles, narrow reflow, contrast, focus and shadow removal
javascript-disabled keeps readable static content with disabled enhancement controls
script-blocked keeps readable static content with disabled enhancement controls
Subpath runtime has no ordinary exceptions, failed resources or external requests

limits: Chromium only; no screen reader, physical device, other browser engine, native zoom/text enlargement, backend or performance benchmark.

Profiles preserve 15 extracted palette aliases, named body/display/mono stacks and panel/control corners, not full theme composition, typography scales, assets, interactions or density. Font binaries are not downloaded.

Contrast excludes hidden/placeholder text, native select popups, browser validation bubbles, glyph internals, SVG/decorative content and antialiasing. Unsupported constructs in measured scope fail rather than silently passing.
A semantic native control, arithmetic pass or bounded screenshot is not full accessibility conformance. Design-fit judgments are reasoned source reviews, separate from browser behavior.
Screenshots remain temporary. No account, backend, agent authority or external network dependency is present.
